review_basis: current registered e-Gov Fire Service Act and Cabinet Order source versions with article/item locators
semantic distinctness, statutory reproducibility and exam relevance

decisions.rationale: Installation permission is a core facility-control proposition and absent from canonical 51.
Change permission is a separate pre-action duty from initial installation permission.
Technical-standard and public-safety permission criteria are exact and independently testable.
Completion inspection before use is a high-value statutory sequence boundary.
Approved provisional use of unaffected portions is a distinct exception to C004.
Transfer/delivery notification is a separate facility-status duty.
The ten-day advance-notice threshold for name/quantity/multiple changes is precise and useful.
Continuous maintenance of technical-standard compliance is distinct from permission-time review.
Repair/change/relocation order is a direct enforcement consequence of noncompliance.
Completion-inspection application procedure is exact and distinct from the substantive use prohibition.
The authority's duty to inspect without delay is a separate procedural proposition.
Certificate issuance after compliance confirmation is a distinct completion-inspection outcome.
Completion-certificate reissue after loss/destruction is source-explicit and independently testable.
The ten-day return duty for a later-found old certificate is a precise administrative boundary.
Class/name/maximum-quantity application fields are exact and distinct from quantity arithmetic.
Specified-quantity multiple as an application field tests administrative use of the value, not recalculation of B1 propositions.
Change content and reason are exact change-application evidence requirements.
Completion pre-inspection for applicable liquid-hazardous-material tanks is a distinct inspection layer.
The outdoor-tank safety-inspection capacity threshold is a high-value facility classification boundary.
Periodic inspection plus record creation/retention is distinct from statutory safety inspection.

collision_review.note: All 20 B6 candidates are source-explicit, materially distinct from canonical 51 and non-colliding with accepted B4/B5 propositions.

source_review_scope: This gate checks source registration, locator reproducibility and answer-binding completeness. Final canonical source verification remains separate.
